subject.title: feat(mattermost): add DM voice call support

question: After the transport defects are fixed, should the bundled Mattermost plugin ship and support this native DM voice-call feature?
rationale: The PR creates a large native media, network, configuration, platform, and operational support surface whose long-term ownership cannot be decided mechanically.

options.title: Ship after transport fixes
options.body: Merge after ICE, reconnect, native packaging, upgrade, and live-call proof are complete.

options.title: Keep it experimental
options.body: Leave the POC outside supported bundled behavior until the platform and lifecycle scope are defined.

recommendation.title: Ship after transport fixes
recommendation.body: Merge after ICE, reconnect, native packaging, upgrade, and live-call proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history signal for Mattermost runtime architecture and plugin ownership.
